goal: First bounded atomistic calculation-to-motion-to-3D path; internal reference systems do not define fixed experiment menus.

model.preferred_implementation: CP2K Quickstep GAPW with POTENTIAL ALL
model.reference_energy: electronic plus nuclear repulsion, no rest energies/ZPE/thermal corrections

density_semantics.hard_density_and_export_selection_gate: A02/A04 must pin and verify full hard+soft density export, grid axes, units and electron integral; no silent replacement by soft density or approximate hard shape
density_semantics.label: Computed electronic state; export approximation and grid resolution remain explicit.

numerical_candidate_sweeps.atomic_grid_and_GAPW_split: A02 must identify version-supported settings and A04 freeze explicit refinement levels
numerical_candidate_sweeps.sweep_policy: Refine one numerical family at a time, keep others fixed at verified fine settings; SCF stop threshold alone is not property convergence.
numerical_candidate_sweeps.scf_threshold_semantics: Version-specific internal SCF stopping metric, not an energy-difference guarantee or universally Hartree-valued property.

freeze_gates.A01: Composition/state/boundary/model intention/reference observables and engineering criteria selected before any engine run.
freeze_gates.A02: Resolve stable engine/build/data versions, full-density export and compatible all-electron basis bytes/hashes.
freeze_gates.A03: Measure installation, resource/time/output/cancellation and protect existing web service.
freeze_gates.A04: Freeze actual engine settings and runtime contracts before scientific acceptance execution. Failure cannot silently change model or tolerances.
